name: A1 SIP Trunk
host_hint: From your A1 customer data sheet. A1 has several connection variants, so agree the setup with A1.
notes: User name, password and addresses are on your A1 customer data sheet. The user name is usually the number with its code, such as +43... Enter the domain from the data sheet as SIP domain. This template is the weakest kind: it comes from another PBX vendor's guide, because A1's own guideline could not be read in full. Faxes go over G.711, not T.38.
